caption: The drawing is a technical architectural plan, rendered in black ink on a cream background, showing three orthographic views of a wooden bed: top elevation, front elevation, and side elevation. The top elevation depicts the bed frame from above, including labeled vertical slats with the letters "S", "L", "A", and "T" across the structure. The front elevation illustrates a view of the bed's headboard, featuring two ornate, turned posts on either side and a gently curved headboard panel between them. The side elevation displays the profile of the bed, showing the posts' height and the horizontal side rail connecting them. To the right, detailed dimensional annotations indicate the thickness and lengths of various bed components, particularly the posts and the headboard, with measurements in inches. A small scale for elevations is located at the upper left corner of the sheet, indicating the relative sizing of the drawing to actual dimensions. The drawing is composed entirely of fine, straight, and curved lines with writing in upper-case letters, and does not include colors other than the black lines and text on the colored background.
title: Doll Bed
